sap_tech_facts_for_researcher.SAP_Analytics_Cloud: Three pillars: BI (dashboards, self-service), Planning (FP&A, integrated business planning), Predictive (machine learning, AI insights). Single SaaS platform. Connects to S/4HANA, BW/4HANA, HANA Cloud, and external sources.
sap_tech_facts_for_researcher.SAP_BusinessObjects: On-premise enterprise BI suite — Crystal Reports, Web Intelligence, Lumira, Design Studio. Being superseded by SAC for net-new deployments; existing customers on migration path.
sap_tech_facts_for_researcher.S4HANA_embedded_analytics: SAP Fiori-based operational reporting tiles built into S/4HANA — real-time KPIs, 1,800+ pre-built CDS views (analytical apps), no separate extraction needed. Complement to SAC, not a replacement.
sap_tech_facts_for_researcher.SAP_Datasphere: Data fabric/data warehouse layer; feeds SAC for analytics. Important in BI architecture alongside SAC.
